However, yesterday saw a strong monsoon surge, with many places, especially in southern Arizona, receiving 1-2 inches of rain. Tucson, Oro Valley, Tombstone, and Benson were hit hard, including central Pima County and southern Pinal County. Sorry, western Arizona and central Phoenix.
